messages:
liz: Heads-up — new partner IntegrateNow wants to go live in the cloud marketplace next month. They sent over SOC excerpts and a short questionnaire. Need a quick compliance sprint to close gaps and align launch comms.

sam: thanks. can we get a single artifact list and owners? i don't want fragmented handoffs. :handshake:

noah: i skimmed their SOC excerpt. missing explicit key-management section and a network segmentation statement. small but blocking for gov-cloud listing.

liz: noted. danielle, can you take KM/KMS attestation? raj — can you own network segmentation artifact?

danielle: +1. i'll request the attestation template from them and ask for KMS ARNs. target EOD tues.

raj: yep. i'll draft a one-page network diagram request and a minimal acceptance checklist. aim for Wed.

sec-bot: automated-scan: Found 2 flagged items in partner questionnaire (password policy, logging retention). See link: https://redwood-internal/reports/1754321987-qna

sam: okay — we should add remediation owners for those items too. marcus, can infra confirm logging retention minimums we require?

marcus: Redwood baseline: 90 days logs for marketplace listings, 365 for enterprise add-on. i'll post the exact policy snippet in a sec.

marcus: Policy: "Marketplace listings must retain audit logs for a minimum of 90 days; evidence must include syslog S3 path and retention lifecycle."

liz: good. i'll add that to the partner ask. two parallel threads: (1) artifact collection (SOC excerpt, KMS attestation, network diagram, questionnaire answers, pen-scan summary) and (2) launch comms freeze date — we need to gate announcement until artifacts validated.

noah: pen-scan — they can either share a vendor report or sign our scoped assessment. recommend we accept vendor report only if it includes OS/infra CVEs and remediation dates.

danielle: for KMS attestation, ask for: key policy export, KMS key ARNs, and statement on HSM usage if any. smallest ask we can live with.

sam: let's make a compact artifact manifest. propose: 1) SOC excerpt (control mapping), 2) KMS attestation, 3) network diagram + segmentation statement, 4) pen-scan summary or vendor report, 5) questionnaire answers (security + dataflow), 6) log retention evidence.

liz: that covers it. i'll send partner the manifest now and request presigned uploads. will include deadline: 7 business days.

liz: message to partner (snip): "Can you upload the manifest items to the Redwood intake bucket (s3 presign links provided) within 7 business days? Please redact PII from screenshots and include checksum files."

raj: presign note — remind them to use object tag 'marketplace:partner=integratenow' so our ingest pipeline picks it up. also request a single zipped package with filenames matching the manifest.

danielle: quick paste for partner KMS ask:

```
Please provide:
- KMS key ARNs used for product encryption
- Key policy export (JSON)
- Statement of HSM involvement (yes/no) and vendor
- Owner contact for key rotation schedule
```

sam: convos around redaction: who owns final scrub? we need a redaction lead so we don't leak customer data when we publish.

noah: product-security should do final redaction signoff. i'll volunteer to coordinate with partner and engineering for redactions.

marcus: small logistics — i'll generate presign links once liz confirms manifest and names. presign expiry 72 hours by default; we can extend to 7 days per upload.

liz: timeline summary: partner notified today, artifacts due in 7 business days, internal validation 3 business days after receipt, final redaction + compliance signoff 2 business days, announcement freeze = validated only.

sam: can we add a fallback model: if vendor pen report missing scope, we do a limited scoped test run with our red team for critical CVEs only? budget approved up to 8 hours triage.

liz: agreed. add as contingency. will mention in the intake note.

sec-bot: reminder scheduled: compliance-review in #partnerships on 1754324000

raj: i've uploaded the network request template to the shared docs folder: https://docs.redwood/network-templates/integratenow

danielle: i've drafted the KMS attestation email to partner, sending in DM for liz to review.

liz: thanks all — i'll post the official manifest + presign links in this thread after i get them from marcus. please ping if you need escalation. :thumbsup:
